Name: Custom More 'Real' Abigail
Author: 343gamers
Description:
[b][font=Georgia][size=4][center][color=#3d85c6]INFO[/color][/center]
[/size][/font][/b]
[size=3]Exactly as the title says, it's Abigail with blue eyes and brown hair. I always felt her character was a bit odd with the bright hair.

Huge thanks to [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/45737217-ddeadboyy/]ddeadboyy[/url] for creating the new Alt. textures! These new textures are added as optional, one with the standard hair and a less pink skin tone; one with Brown hair and alas one with dark brown.[/size]

[b][font=Georgia][size=4][center][color=#3d85c6]INSTALLATION[/color][/center][/size][/font][/b]
[size=3]Extract the RAR to C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley
[/size]
[font=Georgia][color=#3d85c6][size=4][b][center]Work Path[/center][/b][/size][/color][/font][size=3]Change clothes to something more natural.[/size]

[b][size=4][font=Georgia][color=#3d85c6][center]NOTES[/center][/color][/font][/size][/b]
[size=3][b]HIGHLY [/b] recommended to backup your game; if you want the original files back.
Check out Lombus' [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/827/?tab=1&navtag=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fmoddescription%2F%3Fid%3D827%26preview%3D&pUp=1]Abigail's Sprite with Blue Eyes[/url] if you want blue eyes w/o the brown hair!
[/size]
[b][font=Georgia][size=4][center][color=#3d85c6]CREDITS[/color][/center][/size][/font][/b]
[size=3]Thanks to XNBNODE for the exatraction tool.
Thanks ConcernedApe for the wondeful game!
Thanks Suntium for the amazing brown hair!
Thanks [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/45737217-ddeadboyy/]ddeadboyy[/url] for the new Alt. Textures![/size]
